items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Can I ask you a couple questions about Paul Monson?

ctx.x: I didn't wake this week, you see, the hotel guy to have a celebrity. He said we'd pay you even though you weren't here. So I stayed there until almost a year.
Can I ask you a couple questions about Paul Monson? I keep forgetting things, you know.
And if we're finished with Ori there.
